strings.CollectUnusedStylesHint: Remove unused definitions only when all dependencies are covered. Keep defaults and named styles unless copied-name cleanup is enabled separately. Analyze again after changing options.
strings.RemoveCopiedNamedStylesHint: Off by default. A name suffix is only a heuristic, not proof that a style is unused. External programs or templates may use these names. Built-in styles and styles with metadata are retained; VBA, extensions or unknown dependencies prevent cleanup. Review the analysis and keep the original workbook. Analyze again after changing options.
strings.SectionDiagnosticHint: Sizes are standalone UTF-8 serialization bytes. Shares use the total serialized section size. Only known references are counted; ? means unknown. Unreferenced does not mean safe to delete.
strings.ThemeHint: Switch between light and dark themes
strings.GalleryHint: Select images to export. Click a thumbnail to preview. You can also drop images or folders here.
strings.EmptyHint: Import screenshots or images, or drop images and folders onto the window.
strings.DropHint: Drop multiple images or folders, including images in subfolders · PNG · JPEG · BMP
strings.DropNoImages: No supported images found in the dropped items (PNG · JPEG · BMP)
strings.DropErrors: Some dropped items could not be imported:
strings.DropBusy: Import or export is in progress. Try dropping items again when it finishes.
strings.CopyHint: Copy the original image to the clipboard
strings.RemoveAllHint: Clear the workspace while keeping source files and images already exported to Excel
strings.SortTimeHint: Sort by file modification time. New images are sorted automatically; export follows workspace order.
strings.RemoveHint: Remove from the queue; keep the source file
strings.PreviewHint: ← → Switch images · Esc Close · Scroll to explore zoomed images
strings.SettingsHint: Configure image layout, Excel export, and screenshot integration.
strings.SizeHint: Design dimensions use 96 DPI logical pixels. Only display size changes; source images are not resampled.
strings.RulesHint: Each rule: a condition on one line, then scale = value on the next. The first match wins; and takes precedence over or.
strings.CellGapHint: Cell units use actual column widths and row heights; decimals are supported. Horizontal gaps apply only to compact layout. Changes apply to future exports.
strings.SelectAllPictures: Select all worksheet pictures after export
strings.SelectPicturesHint: After a successful export, select all pictures in Excel to move or resize them together. Image queue selections are unchanged.
strings.TemplateHint: Leave blank to use Excel's default template. Each export normalizes row heights and column widths on the target sheet.
strings.SettingsRecovered: Settings were corrupted and have been restored from backup
strings.StartCellHint: Rows and columns start at 1; column 1 is A. Before export, clear pictures from the target sheet, then lay out images from the top-left corner of the specified cell.
strings.StartCellError: Starting row must be an integer from 1 to 1048576; starting column must be an integer from 1 to 16384.
strings.ImportErrors: Some images could not be imported:
strings.ImportCancelled: Import cancelled; imported images are kept
strings.Exported: Export complete. Save the workbook in Excel.
strings.ExportCancelled: Export cancelled; inserted images are kept
strings.NoSelection: Select at least one image to export
strings.NumberError: Enter a valid positive number (gaps may be zero)
strings.ExcelRangeError: Row height must not exceed 409 pt; column width must not exceed 255 characters
strings.CaptureFolderHint: Import only PNG, JPEG, and BMP files added or updated after monitoring starts. Wait for writes to finish and avoid duplicates; queue imports while busy.
strings.CaptureGreenshotHint: Greenshot keeps its own settings, which are preserved on later launches. Set shortcuts and file output in Greenshot; RelaxCat reads its save folder when starting monitoring. When integration is selected, the next RelaxCat launch starts Greenshot and monitoring automatically. Close other Greenshot instances first.
strings.CaptureGreenshotRunning: Greenshot and folder monitoring are running
strings.CaptureGreenshotExited: Greenshot exited unexpectedly and monitoring stopped. Apply again to restart.
strings.CaptureFolderRequired: Choose a valid folder to monitor
strings.CaptureKeysDistinct: The three screenshot shortcuts must be different
strings.CaptureKeyModifier: Letter or number shortcuts require Ctrl, Alt, or Win
strings.CaptureValid: Screenshot settings are valid. Click Apply & start to activate.
strings.CaptureOtherInstance: Another Greenshot instance is running. Close it manually or choose folder monitoring only.
strings.BatchHint: Scan the input folder recursively for .xlsx / .xlsm files and optimize each into the output folder. Source files stay unchanged; processing continues after individual failures.
strings.BatchOutputHint: Output names end in -optimized, preserving subfolders. Existing outputs are skipped by default.
strings.BatchIdle: Choose an input folder, then scan
strings.BatchReady: Scan complete. Ready for batch optimization.
strings.BatchIssues: Some folders could not be read: {0}
strings.BatchInputRequired: Choose an input folder containing .xlsx / .xlsm files
strings.BatchEmpty: Choose a folder and scan to see the file queue and progress here.
strings.ExcelToolHint: Analyze .xlsx / .xlsm style tables and merge identical cell formats. The source file stays unchanged; results are written to a new workbook, with worksheet styles shown before and after.
strings.AnalyzeHint: Analysis reads styles without changing the file. Optimization writes a new file after verification, then analyzes it to show the results.
strings.ExcelToolEmptyHint: Choose an .xlsx or .xlsm workbook and click Analyze to see worksheet styles and duplicate formats that can be merged.
strings.ProjectionHint: After values are estimates calculated during analysis. Actual results are available after optimization.
strings.NoStylesInSheet: This worksheet uses no custom formats
strings.CheckStylesSections: Style sections match the optimization map
strings.CheckCellXfs: Format table matches the optimization map
strings.ExcelAnalyzedDuplicates: Analysis complete: {0} duplicate formats can be merged
strings.ExcelOutputAccessDenied: Cannot write to the output folder: {0}. Try another folder (such as the project folder), or add RelaxCat to your security software's trusted apps (for example, Tencent PC Manager or Windows Defender), then retry.
strings.ExcelSameFile: Output must be different from the source file
